title: Revise icon-only & compact button interactions; fix loading/disabled regressions and align theme tokens
creator: Ava Chen
description: This ticket covers a focused iteration on the Button component family: 1) formalize icon-only / compact button spacing, hover and press micro-interactions; 2) fix recent regressions where loading/disabled states lost visible affordances on high-contrast themes; 3) align button-related tokens with the new theme token naming; 4) produce a concise engineering handoff and QA checklist. The goal is to ship a small, low-risk patch that improves accessibility (keyboard + screen reader), reduces visual regressions across themes, and provides clear token mappings for runtime teams.
acceptance_criteria: Visual spec: icon-only, icon-with-label, and compact variants documented with exact padding, min-size, and icon sizes for 3 breakpoints (desktop/tablet/mobile)
Interaction spec: hover, focus, active, pressed, and loading states have explicit color/opacity/scale values; disabled state includes a distinct high-contrast mode per accessibility guidelines
A11y: Icon-only buttons have accessible name fallback (aria-label or visually hidden text) demonstrated in examples; keyboard focus ring follows brand focus token and is visible at 2x contrast margin
Regression fixes: previously failing snapshots for dark-high-contrast and compact layouts are corrected in design artifacts and referenced in the PR checklist
Tokens: mapping table from legacy button tokens to new theme tokens included (token names and example usage), with a migration note for engineering
Design handoff: Figma component variants updated, annotated, and a single Figma prototype (hover/press/loading) linked in the ticket
QA: Automated visual tests (Percy/Chromatic) and manual checks documented; test plan has explicit steps and expected screenshots
Docs: Console component docs updated with examples for icon-only, loading + spinner placement, and recommended aria patterns
comments: 2026-02-12 — Ava Chen: Discovery notes attached. Observed regressions introduced by runtime token rename; compact icon-only buttons shrank below accessible touch-target on mobile. Need to preserve 44px minimum target where touchable.
2026-02-18 — Marcus Patel (Eng): Confirmed ENG-3245 will include a token alias layer for backward compatibility. We can land design tokens first and add alias mapping in runtime patch.

2026-02-24 — Sofia Ramirez: Updated Figma components to include a11y hidden-label variant and added hover/press motion frames. Shared prototype for review: https://figma.com/proto/button-interactions-2026

2026-02-26 — Design review: PM and Accessibility reviewed. Action items: a) ensure spinner placement doesn't shift layout when loading; b) create a visual regression checklist for dark/high-contrast themes.

2026-03-02 — QA lead (Liam Nguyen): Created preliminary Percy baseline and flagged two dark-theme failures related to disabled opacity. Filed ENG follow-up ENG-3289 for runtime fix if token alias doesn't preserve opacity behavior.

2026-03-04 — Sofia Ramirez: Incorporated QA feedback and finalized token mapping doc. Ready for engineering handoff — see attached mapping PDF. Requesting sprint prioritization for small patch release.
2026-03-05 — Ava Chen: Marked ticket In Progress -> preparing for In Review once ENG-3245 branch includes token aliases and ENG-3289 patch is merged.
notes: Key trade-offs considered: 1) maintain visual parity vs allow slight spacing increases to preserve touch-targets — we chose accessibility and increased compact min-height to 44px; 2) spinner placement: absolute overlay vs inline replacement — chose inline replacement with reserved width to avoid layout shift.
migration_notes: Provide engineering with token mapping table: legacy 'button-bg-primary' -> new 'surface.button.primary-bg', 'button-border' -> 'border.control'. Include aliases in runtime for one release cycle. Add a lint rule to flag direct usage of legacy tokens in components after migration.
qa_plan: Manual: Test keyboard-only navigation across toolbar with mixed icon and text buttons; verify focus ring visibility and readable aria-labels
Manual: Validate spinner appears centered and does not push adjacent content in form rows and toolbars
Visual: Run Percy snapshots for light, dark, and high-contrast themes across desktop and mobile viewport sizes
Automation: Add unit tests for token name fallbacks and visual regression baselines
rollout_plan: Ship as a small design-system patch alongside ENG token alias PR. Release to canary branch first; run visual regression suite. If no regressions, include in next minor console release (console-2026.03). Communicate change notes and migration mapping to platform teams and include a one-week rollback window if major regressions occur. Update release notes with examples and recommended aria patterns.
